proposals.old:
:::terse
The `Step` relation is _normalizing_ it is deterministic and always reaches a normal form
in a finite number of steps.
:::
proposals.new:
:::terse
The `Step` relation is _normalizing_: every term reaches a normal form in
a finite number of steps. Combined with determinism, that normal form is
unique.
:::
proposals.why: `Normalizing` is defined purely as totality (every term reaches a normal form); the previous wording folded determinism into the definition itself, which isn't what `Normalizing` says. State the two facts separately.
